# ghost/nztides

Read named New Zealand port tide events and their explicit displayed time zones in NZ Tides

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/nztides
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/nztides open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/nztides read_tides --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/nztides open_ports --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/nztides scroll_ports --device <serial> --param direction=<direction>
ghost skill run ghost/nztides select_port --device <serial> --param port=<port>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open NZ Tides and read its public Auckland table
- `read_tides`: Read tide events with NO parameters; safely opens default Auckland from Samsung HOME, otherwise requires NZ Tides foreground
- `open_ports`: Open the bundled public port picker and list exposed names
- `scroll_ports`: Scroll the open public port picker down or up
- `select_port`: Select an exact currently exposed public port name
